---
title: Manage Leads
description: >-
  Open specific lead profiles to view details, delete outdated records, and
  duplicate entries to efficiently organize similar sales prospects.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Lead Details.

- Click and view a lead details

- Delete button to delete outdated entries or copy button to duplicate entry.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="247" height="293" style="width: 247px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="598" height="237" style="width: 598px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. In single lead detail page, Duplicate Content for similar prospects or Delete Content to keep your lead list clean and organized.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="607" height="255" style="width: 607px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
